transcript.text: I finally found a backpack that fits all my shoot essentials and actually looks good. As a content creator I'm always carrying my camera, iPad, skincare essentials and a couple of accessories. So I got myself the pivot backpack from daily objects and now everything fits in one place. And the best part, it actually goes with my outfit so I don't have to compromise on style. One less thing to worry about before heading out for a shoot.
